messages:
deploy-bot: preflight evals finished for rc-2026-03-18-2. 1/12 checks failed: prompt-eval `summarization-qa-v2` shows -5.8% semantic score vs baseline. report: https://redwood.internal/evals/rc-2026-03-18-2/summarization-qa-v2 :warning:
anya (ML Eng): on it. opening the report now, looks like failures concentrated on long-newsletter prompts (length > 800 tokens).
eva (QA): saw similar in nightly: a spike in hallucination rate on >700 tokens. failing examples look consistent. I recommend holding promotion until triage. :hand:
ben (Release Lead): thanks. can we hotfix or pin? what are the options and risk surface if we push?
anya (ML Eng): options:
- pin production routing to model `gptx-2@2026-03-05` for the next rollout (fast, low-risk)
- try a quick quant/profile tweak + recompile (might take ~2hrs, risk unknown)
- rollback canary (if already promoted)
ml-ci-bot: test-summary: throughput ok, latency +1ms, perf regressions: none. metric-diff: hallucination_rate +3.2% on subset, semantic_score -5.8%.
carlos (SRE): canary is still in canary stage (10% traffic). throughput steady. no infra alarms. from infra POV, pinning traffic back to older model is the safest immediate move.
ben (Release Lead): agree. let's not promote until ML signs off. anya, can you pin and open a short-lived dedicated patch? include rollback playbook.
anya (ML Eng): creating patch now. command: `pin_model --route default --model gptx-2@2026-03-05 --duration 4h --reason "summ-qa regression"`
anya (ML Eng): also starting a bisect on prompt set to isolate which commit or tokenizer change caused drift. will update in ~45m.
eva (QA): I'll run extended evals on the failed prompts and a larger OOD sample once the pin is live.
ben (Release Lead): notifying product and legal about the hold (change window opened). adding note to release notes: "Promotion paused due to summarization QA regression; pin applied to mitigate"
deploy-bot: canary routing updated: default -> gptx-2@2026-03-05 (pinned by anya). canary paused for rc-2026-03-18-2. link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/rc-2026-03-18-2/status
carlos (SRE): scheduling rollback window at 03:30 UTC if bisect doesn't conclude. I'll be on-call.
ben (Release Lead): quick triage call in 20m in #zoom-triage. @anya @eva please join. if bisect points to a model change, we may need to pin longer and run an RC with narrower prompt sets.
anya (ML Eng): joining. first bisect batch running now.
ml-ci-bot: bisect job started: job 88421. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/88421/artifacts
eva (QA): thanks. adding blocker label to the release in the tracker.
ben (Release Lead): +1 hold. we'll reconvene after bisect results. if anyone sees customer-facing incidents, ping me immediately. :phone:
deploy-bot: note: automatic release gate prevents promotion while blocked. manual override disabled for this release until ML approval.
anya (ML Eng): preliminary bisect indicates a tokenization tweak in commit `fix/token-shim-2026-03-12` might be correlated. running narrower tests now.
ben (Release Lead): good catch. if confirmed, plan: pin production route for 24h, revert token shim in next minor, then re-run full eval suite before re-promote. record that in changelog.
anya (ML Eng): will prepare PR for revert and a follow-up eval run. ETA 3h for PR + CI.
carlos (SRE): I'll hold the rollback window until we've got PR green or decide to proceed with rollback. will update schedule accordingly.
eva (QA): continuing extended regressions. will post detailed failure examples in the triage thread.
ben (Release Lead): closing thread for now — action items assigned. thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: thread closed by ben (Release Lead).
